scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving restaurants & cafés
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Restaurants and Cafés
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: restaurants & cafés — a misunderstanding or problem involving restaurants & cafés
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving restaurants & cafés; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Ms Emma this is not the dish she wanted.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với chị Emma đây không phải món mình muốn.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Emma. This is not the dish I wanted.
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Emma. Đây không phải món tôi muốn.

turns.speaker: Ms Emma
turns.english: Oh, I am sorry. Let me fix that right away.
turns.vietnamese: Ồ, tôi xin lỗi. Để tôi sửa lại ngay.
